context: Routing between figma-to-content (one Figma page onto an existing EDS project's blocks) and stardust reskin's Figma-only path (a whole site whose content and design system both live in Figma, content gated byte-level).

checklist.name: Recognises Figma-only multi-page
checklist.description: Identifies that there is no live site, several page frames, and the design system in the same Figma file.

checklist.name: Routes to reskin Figma-only
checklist.description: Chooses stardust reskin (figma-donor.mjs init/content, Figma text gate) or, when unavailable, says so explicitly instead of running figma-to-content per page.

checklist.name: States the distinction
checklist.description: Explains that figma-to-content builds one page against existing blocks while reskin gates content against the frames and applies the Figma design system across pages.
